'''Mailocs''' were flying [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] predators found on a variety of [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]], [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]],<ref name="DF2" /> and [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]],<ref name="MOTS" /> often found in [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]]. [[Insectoid/Legends|Wasp-like]] and gruesome,<ref name="TCSWE" /> the [[Color/Legends|yellow-brown]] insects were constantly airborne, lacking legs, and also possessed very large, two-pronged stingers<ref name="MOTS" />&mdash;that could penetrate most [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal shields]]<ref name="TCSWE" />&mdash;at the ends of their tails. Red eyed mailocs often  attacked by swooping down on their prey, biting with their small jaws and stinging with their tails. They emitted a high-pitched shriek when excited.<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mailoc first appeared in the [[1997]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' in the third level on Sulon.<ref name="DF2" />
